title: Linearity of the explicit coefficient section map
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a morphism of schemes, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U\subseteq T$ open, $Y=f^{-1}U$, $Z\subseteq Y$ open, and $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Let $g:T'\to U$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to T'$ satisfy $g'f=f'gU.\iota$, and let $W=g'^{-1}(Y.\iota(Z))$. Use the module and pullback conventions of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-module-pullback] and the coefficient scalar convention of [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. Set $N=F|_Y(Z)$ restricted to $A$ along $\Gamma\mathrm{SpecIso}^{-1}$ followed by $(f|_U\circ U.\mathrm{toSpecGamma}).\mathrm{appTop}$, and $P=(U.\mathrm{toSpecGamma})_*g_*(W.\iota\circ f')_*(g'^*F|_W)$. Put $B=g^{-1}(U.\mathrm{toSpecGamma}^{-1}(\mathrm{Spec}(A)))$ and $L=W.\iota((W.\iota\circ f')^{-1}B)$. Define $k:N\to\Gamma(\mathrm{Spec}(A),P)$ by identifying $s$ with $F(Y.\iota(Z))$, applying the pullback unit for $g'$, and restricting to $L$. Then $k(as)=a k(s)$, where the target scalar structure is the global-section module structure transported through $\Gamma\mathrm{SpecIso}^{-1}$. The additive map $k$ is a concrete construction; this theorem supplies only its linearity.

source.place: Tag 02KE, termwise Cech map; Tag 01I6, Lemma 26.7.1; Tags 0096 and 0097, module adjunction and composition

proof.text:
The source scalar is first restricted along the global structural map and
then to Z. The restriction identification transports it through the inverse of
Y.ι.appIso. The pullback unit is linear over the section ring on Y.ι(Z), with
target scalars transported by g'. Restricting to the support transports it once
more. On the target the scalar is transported successively by GammaSpecIso.inv,
U.toSpecGamma, g, fprime and W.ι, followed by W.ι.appIso.inv. Naturality of the
structure maps, the equality gprime f = fprime g U.ι, and the inverse identities
of appIso identify these two composites. Thus both scalar actions agree. Empty
opens cause no exception since restriction maps and linearity remain defined.
